title: Marketech International
description:
micb2b.com Revenue $1.8 Billion Marketech International Corp. (帆宣, TWSE: 6196), is a Taiwanese semiconductor facility engineering and equipment firm founded 27 December 1988 by Margaret Kao and Scott Lin, based at 6F, No. 3-2, Yuanqu Street, Nangang District, Taipei.
It runs four businesses: equipment and materials sales and service, automated gas and chemical supply systems, integrated MEP and cleanroom systems, and custom OEM/ODM equipment manufacturing.
2025 brought NT$51.57 billion of revenue, NT$3.17 billion of net income and record EPS of NT$15.50 on a 10.96 percent gross margin.
Nine months of 2026 already beat that year at NT$57.42 billion, up 55.5 percent, with EPS of NT$18.52 and October alone at NT$7.33 billion, up 77 percent.
Backlog was NT$135.1 billion in September 2026 and analysts see NT$157.8 to 165.7 billion by November, visibility to 2028; TSMC is 15 to 20 percent of sales, with 7 Taiwan plants, 33 subsidiaries, 2,269 staff and Foxconn ownership.
